description:
Define the OctoPi.Agent.Extension behaviour and implement OctoPi.Agent.ExtensionRunner,
providing a hook-based system for event handlers that need return values (cancel,
modify) — complementing the existing Subscribers system (notifications only).

Reference: tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/types.ts

## OctoPi.Agent.Extension behaviour

Create apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/extension.ex:

  @type event_result ::
    :ok
    | {:ok, modifications :: map()}
    | {:cancel, reason :: term()}

  @callback on_event(event_type :: atom(), payload :: map(), ctx :: map()) :: event_result()
  @optional_callbacks [on_event: 3]

The ctx map contains at minimum:
  %{
    session_pid: pid(),
    is_idle?: boolean(),
    signal: AbortRef.t() | nil   # set during streaming runs
  }

## OctoPi.Agent.ExtensionRunner

Create apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/extension_runner.ex.
A GenServer, one per session, that holds registered extensions and dispatches events.

State:
  %{extensions: [{module(), term()}]}   # {module, initial_state} pairs in order

Public API:

  start_link/1    — (session_pid: pid()) to allow building the ctx map
  register/2      — (runner_pid, module) — appends to extensions list
  emit/3          — (runner_pid, event_type, payload) -> :ok | {:cancelled, reason} | {:modified, map()}

## emit/3 dispatch semantics

Two classes of events:

Cancellable events (stop at first cancel, return {:cancelled, reason}):
  :session_before_compact, :session_before_fork, :session_before_tree,
  :tool_call, :input

Result-modifiable events (merge all {:ok, modifications} returns, last-writer-wins):
  :context, :before_provider_request, :after_provider_response,
  :before_agent_start, :tool_result

Notification-only events (dispatch all, return :ok regardless):
  all other event types

For each extension in order:
  1. Call module.on_event(event_type, payload, ctx).
  2. If cancellable and returns {:cancel, reason}: stop, return {:cancelled, reason}.
  3. If modifiable and returns {:ok, mods}: merge mods into accumulator.
  4. If :ok: no-op.
  5. If the module doesn't export on_event/3 (optional callback): skip.

## Wire into Session

In session.ex init/1: if extensions: [...] is in opts, start ExtensionRunner and
register each module.
Store the pid in state.extension_runner.

Add Session.register_extension/2 :: (pid, module) -> :ok
  calls ExtensionRunner.register/2.

Add Session.emit_hook/3 :: (session_pid, event_type, payload) -> result
  Returns :ok if state.extension_runner is nil (backward compat — sessions without
  extensions work exactly as before).

## Tests

Create apps/octo_pi_agent/test/octo_pi/agent/extension_runner_test.exs.
  - cancellable event stops at first {:cancel, reason} and returns {:cancelled, reason}
  - result-modifiable event merges maps from multiple handlers in order
  - notification event calls all handlers and returns :ok
  - extension module without on_event/3 is skipped gracefully
  - session with no extension_runner: emit_hook returns :ok without crashing
title: Extension behaviour and ExtensionRunner
